title: Ye meri zindagi maula ke naam hai
body:
Ye meri zindagi maula ke naam hai
Maula maula mere maula, Mere maula maula maula..
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula maula mere maula maula
Mere maula maula maula...
<<DIVIDER>>
Unke naam se mera duniya me naam hai
Ye meri zindagi maula ke naam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Unke naam se...
1. Naam o nisha kuch mai rakhta na tha
<<DIVIDER>>
Par aap ne kya se kya kar diya
Karta raha zikr mai aapka
<<DIVIDER>>
Badhta raha yu mera martaba
Aapki khake qadam mera maqaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye meri zindagi maula ke naam hai
2. Nauha gari, shayari, zakiri
<<DIVIDER>>
Saari hai ye khidmate aapki
Na jaho mansab na daulat kabhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Beshak kisike na kaam aaegi
Kaam aanewala bus maula ka naam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye meri zindagi maula ke naam hai
3. Maula tere naam ki barkatein
<<DIVIDER>>
Humko jo hasil hui rif'atein
Ye maal kya, kya hai ye daulatein
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu humse khush ho ye hai jannatein
Teri miljae riza rab ka in'aam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye meri zindagi maula ke naam hai
4. Hu mai faqat tere darr ka ghulam
<<DIVIDER>>
Chaukhat pe teri rahunga mudaam
Nauha padhu aur bheju salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
Khidmat azaa ki hai bus mera kaam
lab par tera tazkera har subho shaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye meri zindagi maula ke naam hai
5. Ye kaif duniya na degi kabhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Farshe azaa hai meri zindagi
Bus is azaa ke hawale se hi
<<DIVIDER>>
Rakhegi duniya mujhe yaad bhi
Koi kya jane jo zakir ka maqaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye meri zindagi maula ke naam hai
6. Mehfil ye majlis azaa ka samaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Rakhte hai humko sadaa shadmaa
Majid jo duniya ka hai saebaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Bus wo hai apne imam e zamaa
Humko faqr hai zinda apna imaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye meri zindagi maula ke naam hai
author: Shadman Raza
